notablePrerequisites:
You control at least six permanents.
Myojin of Blooming Dawn has at least one indestructible counter on it.
description:
Activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, causing you to create two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens for each permanent you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar eight times by sacrificing eight Spirits, adding {5}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Mondrak by paying {1}{W}{W} and sacrificing two Spirits, putting an indestructible counter on it.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving an indestructible counter from Mondrak onto Myojin.
Repeat.
